lines: Do you feel anxious before exams or a sports contest?
Do you feel bad after fighting with your friend?
These are all signs of stress.
When you worry a lot about something, you feel stressed.
You might not sleep or eat well.
Or you might sleep or eat too much.
You might have stomach aches or headaches, too.
Then what can you do to reduce your stress?
Breathe slowly and drink some water to relax.
Take a walk and listen to your favorite music.
You can talk to a teacher, a parent, or a friend.
They can help you to manage your stress.
body.text: Do you feel anxious before exams or a sports contest? Do you feel bad after fighting with your friend? These are all signs of stress. When you worry a lot about something, you feel stressed. And stress causes health problems. You might not sleep or eat well. Or you might sleep or eat too much. You might have stomach aches or headaches, too. Then what can you do to reduce your stress? Breathe slowly and drink some water to relax. Take a walk and listen to your favorite music. You will feel much better. Talk about your worries. You can talk to a teacher, a parent, or a friend. They can help you to manage your stress.
